header.tripleZero: Call Triple Zero (000) if someone may be seriously unwell.

heatRisk.title: Heat Risk
heatRisk.intro: Live local forecast and personalised heat guidance.
heatRisk.source: Forecast data provided by Open-Meteo. Heat guidance is not an official warning.
heatRisk.unavailableTitle: We couldn’t update the weather right now.
heatRisk.chartSummary: The chart compares forecast air temperature with apparent temperature from morning to evening. The highest apparent temperature is {{temp}}.
heatRisk.similarEvening: Temperatures may remain similar this evening. Carry water and consider a cool indoor rest location.
heatRisk.basedOnFeels: Warmest periods are based on live apparent temperature.
heatRisk.scaleNote: These temperature ranges are used for travel recommendations. The overall heat-risk rating can also be raised by daily highs, overnight lows or UV levels.
heatRisk.selectCircumstances: Select one or more circumstances to see personalised safety suggestions.

message.comfortable: Conditions are currently comfortable. Normal care is usually enough.
message.warm: Warm conditions today. Plan water, shade and comfortable travel times.
message.hot: Hot conditions are expected. Avoid long outdoor periods during the warmest hours.
message.very-hot: Very hot conditions are expected. Change outdoor plans where possible and prepare a cooler place.

advice.comfortable: Keep water nearby and enjoy your day with normal care.
advice.warm: Carry water, use sunscreen, wear light clothing and choose shade when you can.
advice.hot: Consider shorter outdoor trips, cooler rest stops and a later travel time.
advice.very-hot: Prepare water, cooling options, transport plans and check in with friends.

coolPlaces.title: Cool Places
coolPlaces.description: Find air-conditioned spaces, water access, and transport-friendly demo stops.
coolPlaces.disclaimer: Cooling places shown in this prototype are demonstration locations and have not been independently verified.
coolPlaces.emptyTitle: No demo cooling places match these filters.
coolPlaces.emptyBody: Try removing one of the filters.
coolPlaces.directionsBody: This is a demonstration location used for the prototype. Would you like to preview directions to its map coordinates?
coolPlaces.locationDenied: Location access was not enabled. The map is showing central Melbourne.

dashboard.privacyBody: GPS coordinates are used only for the current weather request. HeatSafe does not permanently store your precise GPS location.
dashboard.loadErrorTitle: We could not load live weather just now.
dashboard.loadErrorBody: Please check your connection or try another suburb.
dashboard.signsBody: Dizziness, fainting, severe headache, vomiting, confusion or unusual weakness can mean someone needs help.
dashboard.healthdirectBody: Call 1800 022 222 for health advice in Australia.
dashboard.emergencyReminderBody: Confusion, collapse, seizures or loss of consciousness may indicate a medical emergency. Call Triple Zero (000).
dashboard.remindersBody: Keep these small steps available, even on comfortable days.
dashboard.notificationsBody: Optional browser notifications are only sent for warmer days, and no more than once every six hours.
dashboard.disclaimer: HeatSafe provides general heat-safety guidance and does not replace professional medical advice or official emergency information.
dashboard.notificationBody: Today may reach {{temp}}{{difference}}. Consider a cooler travel time and carry water.

prep.avoid: Avoid long outdoor activities during the hottest hours

travel.intro: Check whether your travel time overlaps with the hottest part of the day.
travel.missing: Enter both starting location and destination.
travel.hot: Leaving after 5:30 PM may feel more comfortable.
travel.warm: This journey may still feel warm, especially during transfers.
travel.comfortable: This journey avoids the warmest part of the day.
travel.resultBody: Use the form to generate a travel heat-risk summary.
alternatives: Stop at a nearby cool place

safety.title: Personal Safety Plan
safety.intro: Create, save, preview, edit, or print your heatwave plan.
safety.disclaimer: General safety guidance only. This app does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice.
safety.saved: Your safety plan has been saved to this device.
safety.actionsBeforeBody: Close blinds early, chill water, prepare light meals, charge devices, and plan time in an air-conditioned place.
safety.actionsDuringBody: Stay indoors during peak heat, drink water regularly, avoid unnecessary outdoor travel, and seek help if you feel unwell.
checklist: Carry water, sunscreen, hat, and charged phone.
Check public transport disruptions before leaving.

learn.title: Learn
learn.intro: Short explanations and quick quizzes for international students in Australia.

terms.triple: Triple Zero (000): call for police, fire, or ambulance emergencies.
terms.ambulance: Ambulance: medical emergency transport and urgent care.
terms.gp: GP: a general practitioner, often the first doctor for non-emergency health concerns.

heatwave.title: What an Australian heatwave is
heatwave.body: Several very hot days and warm nights can make it hard for your body and home to cool down.
heatwave.quiz: True or false: warm nights can increase heat risk.

feels.title: Understanding feels like temperature
feels.body: Feels like temperature combines heat, humidity, wind, and sun exposure to describe how hot your body may feel.
feels.quiz: Which is safer to use for planning: air temperature only, or feels like temperature?

uv.title: Understanding the UV Index
uv.body: Extreme UV can damage skin quickly. Use shade, protective clothing, sunglasses, and SPF 30+ sunscreen.
uv.quiz: At Extreme UV, should you use sun protection even for short trips?

home.title: Preparing accommodation
home.body: Close blinds before rooms heat up, use fans safely, drink water, and move to a cool public place if your room stays hot.
home.quiz: Should you wait until you feel very unwell before leaving a hot room?

travel.title: Staying safe while travelling
travel.body: Avoid peak heat, choose air-conditioned transport, carry water, and pause at cool places between transfers.
travel.quiz: Name one way to reduce travel heat risk.
travel.answer: Travel earlier, use air-conditioned transport, or stop at a cool place.

uni.title: Staying safe at university
uni.body: Use libraries, student hubs, labs, and shaded routes. Ask student services where cool rest areas are located.
uni.quiz: What campus spaces are often cooler?
uni.answer: Libraries, student hubs, labs, and shaded buildings.

help.title: Recognising someone may need help
help.body: Warning signs include dizziness, confusion, fainting, severe headache, hot dry skin, or vomiting.
help.quiz: Is confusion during extreme heat a serious warning sign?

doctor.title: When to contact a health professional
doctor.body: Seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen. Call Triple Zero (000) if someone may be seriously unwell.
doctor.quiz: What number is used for emergencies in Australia?

emergency.title: Choose the situation
emergency.intro: This prototype provides general information and does not replace professional medical advice.
emergency.unsure: If you are unsure and symptoms are serious, seek urgent help. Heat illness can worsen quickly.
emergency.confirmBody: Only call 000 if someone may need urgent police, fire, or ambulance help.

advice.title: I need general safety advice
advice.body: Move to a cooler place, drink water, avoid outdoor activity, and check on friends or housemates.

unwell.title: I feel unwell
unwell.body: Stop activity, move to air conditioning or shade, sip water, loosen tight clothing, and contact a health professional if symptoms continue.

emergency.title: This may be an emergency
emergency.body: Call Triple Zero (000) for emergency assistance in Australia.

location.body: Allow location access to receive local heat information and nearby cooling suggestions. Your precise location will not be saved.

heatStatus.comfortableMsg: Conditions are close to the usual temperature for this location.
heatStatus.warmerMsg: Today is warmer than usual. A few small preparations may help you stay comfortable.
heatStatus.highMsg: High heat is expected today. Consider adjusting outdoor plans during the hottest hours.
heatStatus.persistentMsg: Hot days and warm nights are expected to continue. Your body may have less time to recover overnight.
heatStatus.comparison: Today may reach {{temp}}, around {{difference}}°C {{direction}} than usual for this location.
heatStatus.warmNights: Warm nights can reduce recovery, so prepare cool rest options.
heatStatus.checkFriends: Check in with friends or housemates.

newWeather.label: New to Australian weather
newWeather.text: Treat forecast heat seriously even if the morning feels mild. Melbourne can become dangerous quickly after midday.

noAircon.label: No air conditioning
noAircon.text: Plan to spend the hottest hours in a library, shopping centre, university building, or designated cooling centre.

university.label: Travelling to university
university.text: Travel before 11 AM or after 6 PM where possible, and keep transfers short and shaded.

outdoors.label: Working outdoors
outdoors.text: Ask about extra breaks, shade, sunscreen, water access, and moving heavy tasks away from peak heat.

alone.label: Living alone
alone.text: Share your plan with a trusted friend and set a check-in time during the hottest part of the day.

journey.comparison: Best available option for both endpoints at or after departure, before 9 PM on the same day; it may still be hot.
journey.source: {{provider}} forecast for {{location}} · {{timezone}}. This estimate uses departure-hour weather, not conditions along the entire route.
journey.nextDeparture: Next occurrence of this time in {{timezone}}.
journey.unavailableRecommendation: A departure recommendation needs weather data.

places.hint: Search Australia, with Melbourne and Victoria prioritised. Choose a matching location.
places.selected: Location selected. Editing the text requires a new selection.
places.empty: No matching locations. Try a longer name, street address or suburb.
places.unavailable: Location search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
places.configuration: Location search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
places.rateLimit: Location search is temporarily rate-limited. Please wait before trying again.
places.count_one: {{count}} suggestion available. Use arrow keys and Enter to select.
places.count_other: {{count}} suggestions available. Use arrow keys and Enter to select.
places.required: Choose both starting location and destination from the search suggestions before checking heat risk.
places.durationHelp: Your own estimate. No routing service is connected; we do not calculate travel or arrival times.
places.scope: Checks weather at your selected starting location and destination at departure time. It does not assess the whole route or arrival conditions.
places.explanation: For departure at {{time}} on {{date}}, {{start}} feels like {{originTemp}} (UV {{originUv}}) and {{destination}} feels like {{destinationTemp}} (UV {{destinationUv}}).
places.source: Open-Meteo forecasts at both endpoints at the same instant; the higher endpoint risk is shown. Times use {{timezone}}. Route and arrival conditions are not assessed.

routePlanner.scope: Uses Geoapify route estimates and Open-Meteo forecasts. Compares weather for your departure and options one and two hours later, before 9 pm. The same estimated travel duration is used for each option.
routePlanner.explanation: Leaving {{start}} at {{time}} on {{date}} feels like {{originTemp}} (UV {{originUv}}). At the estimated arrival in {{destination}}, it feels like {{destinationTemp}} (UV {{destinationUv}}).
routePlanner.source: Open-Meteo endpoint forecasts across the journey window; Geoapify route estimates. All times use {{timezone}}. This is a planning estimate, not a personal health assessment. Route weather, shade and vehicle cooling are unknown.
routePlanner.coverage: {{checked}} of {{total}} requested departure options had both route and forecast data. Unavailable options are excluded.
routePlanner.exposureNote: Walking and cycling count the estimated journey as outdoors. Public transport waiting, shelter and driving exposure are unknown; no outdoor-time estimate is shown for these modes.
routePlanner.mapsNote: Opens a fresh directions search in Google Maps without an API key. Set your departure time there to check services; those schedules are not imported into this planner.
routePlanner.routeWarning: Walking and cycling routes may omit clear paths, sidewalks or cycle paths. Check the route before travelling.

reasons.same: No meaningful improvement was found among the available options checked. This does not mean conditions are safe.
reasons.risk: This is the earliest checked option with a lower forecast heat category, without worse peak UV or substantially longer travel or outdoor time.
reasons.cooler: This is the earliest checked option at least 2°C cooler at the endpoint peak, without worse UV or substantially longer travel or outdoor time.
reasons.uv: This is the earliest checked option with peak UV at least 2 points lower, without hotter conditions or substantially longer travel or outdoor time.
reasons.outdoors: This is the earliest checked transit option with at least 10 fewer estimated outdoor minutes, without hotter conditions or worse UV.

errors.routesConfiguration: Journey routing is not configured yet. Please try again once the service is available.
errors.routesUnavailable: Route information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.noRoute: No supported route was found for this method. Try another method, or check public transport directions in Google Maps below.
errors.invalidTime: This departure time is not available in the starting location’s timezone. Please choose another time.
errors.weatherUnavailable: Complete forecast data through arrival is unavailable. No recommendation can be made.

routePlanner.estimateNote: Route duration is an estimate, not a departure-specific timetable or live traffic prediction. Transit waiting and service availability at your chosen time are not verified. Confirm schedules in Google Maps before travelling.
